metadata.title: The Running-Balance Bug Hiding in a Correct-Looking SQL Query
metadata.description: A real SQL correctness bug found and fixed in this book's Chapter 8 worked example: a date filter applied inside the running-balance CTE, before the cumulative SUM() OVER, silently truncating balance history for any account with pre-2026 activity. Fixed by moving the filter downstream to last_posting_per_month.
